description: This file implements a generic CRUD controller factory for Mongoose models with tenant enforcement, including utility functions for validation, caching, payload sanitization, and error handling.

methods.name: validateSort(sort, allowed = ['timestamp', 'created_at', '_id'])
methods.description: Ensures the sort string is within allowed fields and prefixes with '-' for descending if needed.

methods.name: clampLimit(limit, max = 500)
methods.description: Limits pagination size to a maximum value for safety.

methods.name: microGet(key)
methods.description: Retrieves cached list data if not expired.

methods.name: microSet(key, payload)
methods.description: Stores list data in cache with expiry TTL.

methods.name: buildListKey(req, filter, sort, page, limit, skip, explicit)
methods.description: Creates a cache key for list requests based on request parameters.

methods.name: sanitizePayloadWithTenant(req)
methods.description: Sanitizes incoming create/update payloads, injecting tenant ID from request context if available.

methods.name: mergeFilterWithTenant(filter, tenantId)
methods.description: Merges a provided filter with tenant-based constraints, ignoring client-provided tenant hints.

methods.name: buildCrudController(Model, listDefaultSort = '-timestamp')
methods.description: Constructs a CRUD controller for a given Mongoose model with tenant enforcement, including methods for list, getById, create, update, remove.
